title.narrative: Empowered Marasbit Community for Good Governance and Peaceful Co-existence

description.narrative: Diocese of Marsabit seeks to maximise benefits of devolution for good governance and peaceful co- existence. The project will work with 10 advocacy groups formed under ABG1 and create 6 additional groups. These 16 groups will be transitioned into county education and leadership teams through training. Thus formation and training of County Education and Leadership Teams (CELTs) of men and women selected at ward level to ensure participation in county processes. Civic education processes through the Church Structures, media house, public forums on role of county governments. Capacity building of county authorities through training on county functions, county law making processes, development of county strategic planning and budgeting processes. Establishment of county liaison (form of county parliamentary liaison desk to link county leadership teams to county authority and national assembly. Creation of enablers of citizen participation and effectiveness of Church in promoting democratic devolution processes. Key aspect of participation entails engagement of citizens in county budgeting and monitoring processes. Documentation of county citizen centred social audits. These County Education and Leadership teams will have a multiple functions as a community resource group to provide information and facilitate engagements, public expenditure monitors and agents of peace. Being a conflict context, interfaith council forum will be formed to promote dialogue on governance and peace issues. DOM strengthened community advocacy structures through formation of 10 community advocacy groups to monitor service delivery in the water, education and security sector. These groups registered great success in mounting pressure on government agencies to address development needs of the communities. This project is premised on this background and it aims to continue strengthening the existing advocacy groups in Bubisa, Karare,Dukana, Bori, Qilita, Kargi, Korr, Loiyangalani, Dirid-Gombo Sololo parishes and will form and training six new groups in Laisamis, Ileret, North Horr and Maikona parishes Diocese of Marsabit activities will link with national activities to be carried out by CJPC Kenya. Of essence is the civic education manual being developed by CJPC, the Diocese will adapt it as its training manual of advocacy groups (CELTS) and county government. Key advocacy issues from Marsabit County warranting national attention will be picked up and supported by Bishops advocacy committee CJPC Kenya. The county parliamentary liaison officer will learn from and link up with parliamentary liaison officer based at CJPC national office. This is a two year project with budget allocations of Year 1 £ 40,000 Year 2 £ 40,000.
